recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: whispers along the rumor line—more lab-built minds inching toward the public square
a spring-numbered UNIX release landing soft as a keyed lock catching
speculative scaffoldings toward sulfur skies drifting through hacker-daydream threads
clear-air May evening on the peninsula, thirteen degrees with a shrug of wind off the bay
golden hour lingering past eight—a Tuesday that refuses to darken early

composer-2-fast.concept: Catch falling waveform shards on alternating lanes in pocket with micro-stuttering house pulses; clipping three shards collapses your lane inward like muted audio.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: lane switch / rhythmic catch split across left-right zones
composer-2-fast.touch_control: tap left or right half to snap the catcher to that lane
composer-2-fast.session_hook: one condensed track-length round where staying on-beat visibly paints the skyline
composer-2-fast.escalation: ghost pulses and half-beat bait notes after each clean eight-bar streak
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: neon spectrum ridges over a noir desert highway

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Trace one continuous ribbon through dissipating fog banks above a pastel bay sunrise; greedy shortcuts leave cold gaps that stall your score bleed.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: draw-path navigation with occlusion that hides dead ends until you lift your finger
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag to inscribe route, lift to validate and commit fog burn-off
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each clean trace reveals another slice of shoreline gradient for the next sixty seconds
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: moving barges carve temporary holes in playable mist
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: gouache morning marine layer over SF silhouette

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Choreograph a constellation of syslog fireflies: watch a scrambled 3-by-4 grid blink a pattern, then tap cells in reverse temporal order without peeking overlays.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: spatial memory reversal with blackout beats between glimpses
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: sequential taps on phosphor-lit cells after each memorize window closes
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: every perfect rewind rebuilds one missing HUD glyph around the bezel
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: single-frame monochrome glitches smear neighboring cells briefly mid-recall
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: green phosphor CRT bloom with serif status ticks

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sling pea-sized salvage pods through shifting gravity knots toward docking rings orbiting watercolor planets; chaining ricochets ignites dormant rings.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: physics sling with visible gravity cones and angled bumper rings
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: pull back and release sling band on circular launch pad
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: multi-bounce trick shots spit confetti orbital debris fireworks
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: tidal nodes migrate across the orbit field every few launches
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: cut-paper celestial bodies dipped in spilled ink gradients
